canonical_name: 4BSD traceroute routing diagnostic tool (Van Jacobson, 1988 announcement generation)

announced.notes: Date preserved in reproduced mailing-list headers; original archive still sought.

roles: discover responding forwarding hops using increasing TTL probes

operations.diagnostics: Primary purpose: expose likely forwarding hops and RTTs by deliberate TTL expiry.
operations.failure_behavior: Missing responses do not prove absent hops; ICMP filtering/rate limiting/asymmetric paths/load balancing can hide or distort results.
operations.operator_interface: Command-line hop list with probe RTTs; exact default/probe format needs source-level preservation.

open_questions: Recover primary 1988 mailing-list archive and original source tarball.
Diff early traceroute releases and required 4BSD kernel TTL patch.
Trace UDP, ICMP and TCP traceroute variants separately.

sources.notes: Source hosting is secondary; original message archive remains priority.

notes: IP TTL and ICMP Time Exceeded predate traceroute; the tool composes existing mechanisms into an operational diagnostic.
